purpose: Explain an expected response to a notable circumstance.
keywords: give explain a reason cause result
N / plain clause + とあって
Since admission was free, the venue was packed.
It is the first snow, so the children are delighted.
With a famous writer coming, a long line formed.
Make circumstances a reason or a setting
formation: N / plain clause + とあって
restrictions: The circumstance is presented as true and explanatory.
mistake: Unlike とあれば, it normally explains an actual situation.
